<?php
/**
 * WebSocket Multi-Tenant Server - Tenant Isolation Layer
 * Handles message routing between tenants with role-based access control
 */

class TenantContext {
    private string $tenantId;
    private string $userId;
    private int $roleLevel;
    private array $permissions;

    public function __construct(string $tenantId, string $userId, int $roleLevel, array $permissions) {
        $this->tenantId = $tenantId;
        $this->userId = $userId;
        $this->roleLevel = $roleLevel;
        $this->permissions = $permissions;
    }

    public function getTenantId(): string { return $this->tenantId; }
    public function getUserId(): string { return $this->userId; }
    public function getRoleLevel(): int { return $this->roleLevel; }
    public function hasPermission(string $perm): bool { return in_array($perm, $this->permissions, true); }
}

class MessageRouter {
    private array $connections = [];
    private array $tenantAdmins = [];

    public function registerConnection(string $connId, TenantContext $ctx): void {
        $this->connections[$connId] = $ctx;
        if ($ctx->getRoleLevel() >= 90) {
            $this->tenantAdmins[$ctx->getTenantId()][] = $connId;
        }
    }

    public function getContext(string $connId): ?TenantContext {
        return $this->connections[$connId] ?? null;
    }

    public function getTenantAdmins(string $tenantId): array {
        return $this->tenantAdmins[$tenantId] ?? [];
    }
}

class AccessControlEvaluator {
    private const ROLE_USER = 10;
    private const ROLE_MODERATOR = 50;
    private const ROLE_ADMIN = 90;
    private const ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN = 100;

    /**
     * Evaluate whether a request crosses tenant boundaries.
     * Returns true if access should be DENIED.
     */
    public function isCrossTenantViolation(TenantContext $requester, string $targetTenantId): bool {
        // Super admins can access any tenant
        if ($requester->getRoleLevel() >= self::ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN) {
            return false;
        }
        return $requester->getTenantId() !== $targetTenantId;
    }

    /**
     * Check if the requester can perform an administrative action.
     * Validates both role level and tenant scope.
     */
    public function canPerformAdminAction(TenantContext $requester, string $targetTenantId, string $action): bool {
        if ($this->isCrossTenantViolation($requester, $targetTenantId)) {
            return false;
        }
        return $this->evaluateActionPermission($requester, $action);
    }

    private function evaluateActionPermission(TenantContext $ctx, string $action): bool {
        $requiredLevel = $this->getRequiredLevel($action);
        return $ctx->getRoleLevel() >= $requiredLevel;
    }

    private function getRequiredLevel(string $action): int {
        $actionLevels = [
            'read_logs' => self::ROLE_MODERATOR,
            'manage_users' => self::ROLE_ADMIN,
            'modify_config' => self::ROLE_ADMIN,
            'delete_tenant_data' => self::ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN,
        ];
        return $actionLevels[$action] ?? self::ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN;
    }
}

class WebSocketCommandHandler {
    private MessageRouter $router;
    private AccessControlEvaluator $acl;

    public function __construct(MessageRouter $router, AccessControlEvaluator $acl) {
        $this->router = $router;
        $this->acl = $acl;
    }

    /**
     * Handle incoming WebSocket frame after authentication.
     */
    public function handleFrame(string $connId, array $frame): array {
        $ctx = $this->router->getContext($connId);
        if ($ctx === null) {
            return ['error' => 'unauthenticated'];
        }

        $command = $frame['command'] ?? '';
        $payload = $frame['payload'] ?? [];

        return match($command) {
            'admin.execute' => $this->handleAdminExecute($ctx, $payload),
            'tenant.query' => $this->handleTenantQuery($ctx, $payload),
            'tenant.escalate' => $this->handleEscalationRequest($ctx, $payload),
            default => ['error' => 'unknown_command'],
        };
    }

    private function handleAdminExecute(TenantContext $ctx, array $payload): array {
        $targetTenant = $payload['tenant_id'] ?? $ctx->getTenantId();
        $action = $payload['action'] ?? '';

        if (!$this->acl->canPerformAdminAction($ctx, $targetTenant, $action)) {
            return ['error' => 'access_denied', 'reason' => 'insufficient_privileges'];
        }

        return ['status' => 'executed', 'action' => $action, 'tenant' => $targetTenant];
    }

    private function handleTenantQuery(TenantContext $ctx, array $payload): array {
        $targetTenant = $payload['tenant_id'] ?? $ctx->getTenantId();

        if ($this->acl->isCrossTenantViolation($ctx, $targetTenant)) {
            return ['error' => 'access_denied', 'reason' => 'cross_tenant_violation'];
        }

        return ['status' => 'ok', 'data' => 'tenant_data_for_' . $targetTenant];
    }

    /**
     * Handle role escalation requests within a tenant.
     * Only tenant admins can approve escalation for users in their own tenant.
     */
    private function handleEscalationRequest(TenantContext $ctx, array $payload): array {
        $targetUserId = $payload['target_user'] ?? '';
        $requestedLevel = (int)($payload['new_level'] ?? 0);
        $targetTenant = $payload['tenant_id'] ?? $ctx->getTenantId();

        // Verify the requester is an admin
        if (!$this->acl->canPerformAdminAction($ctx, $targetTenant, 'manage_users')) {
            return ['error' => 'access_denied'];
        }

        // Validate escalation bounds - admin cannot grant higher than their own level
        if ($requestedLevel > $ctx->getRoleLevel()) {
            return ['error' => 'cannot_escalate_above_own_level'];
        }

        // Apply the escalation
        return $this->applyEscalation($targetUserId, $targetTenant, $requestedLevel, $ctx);
    }

    private function applyEscalation(string $userId, string $tenantId, int $newLevel, TenantContext $approver): array {
        // Reconstruct context to verify tenant membership of target
        // NOTE: In production this would query a database
        $effectiveTenant = $this->resolveEffectiveTenant($userId, $tenantId, $approver);

        return [
            'status' => 'escalated',
            'user' => $userId,
            'tenant' => $effectiveTenant,
            'new_level' => $newLevel,
            'approved_by' => $approver->getUserId(),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Resolve the effective tenant for a user escalation.
     * If the user belongs to multiple tenants, use the approver's context
     * to determine which tenant membership to escalate.
     */
    private function resolveEffectiveTenant(string $userId, string $requestedTenant, TenantContext $approver): string {
        // Cross-reference: if the approver is a super-admin, allow any tenant
        // Otherwise, constrain to the approver's tenant
        $approverLevel = $approver->getRoleLevel();
        
        // Only super-admins (level >= 100) can escalate across tenants
        if ($approverLevel >= 100) {
            return $requestedTenant;
        }
        
        return $approver->getTenantId();
    }
}

// Bootstrap
$router = new MessageRouter();
$acl = new AccessControlEvaluator();
$handler = new WebSocketCommandHandler($router, $acl);

// Simulated connection setup
$adminCtx = new TenantContext('tenant-A', 'admin-1', 90, ['manage_users', 'read_logs']);
$router->registerConnection('conn-001', $adminCtx);

// Process incoming frame
$incomingFrame = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?? [];
if (!empty($incomingFrame)) {
    $result = $handler->handleFrame('conn-001', $incomingFrame);
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode($result);
}
